normalized_power.tolerance_note: Absolute tolerance of ±0.01 W on the rounded integer result. Since the result is always an integer, the effective tolerance is exact equality.
normalized_power.final_value_tolerance_note: ±0.1% relative tolerance on the unrounded final_value.

tss.tolerance_note: Exact integer equality — TSS rounds to a whole number.
tss.verification_note: Hand-verified against compute_running_tss with ftp_w=280, NP=268 (from streams), duration=2700s. IF=268/280=0.9571, TSS=round(0.75*0.9571^2*100)=69.
